Optional: enable Aerial Legacy in system accessibility settings to return here when the stock home appears. No keys are filtered. Some vendor home screens do not send accessibility events. Opening the stock home tile pauses the guard until you reopen Aerial Legacy. Disable this service in the same settings to restore normal behavior.

Android 4.4+ compatibility edition based on Aerial 1.43. Native remote interface and H.264 playback. Separate package and preferences. 4K/HDR, phone setup, folders, parental PIN, weather and automatic updates are not included. Boot and home guard are off by default. Vendor HOME and boot restrictions may still apply. Public Apple videos may fall back to HTTP if the old system cannot establish HTTPS.
